rules: Never join measurements by marketing model name alone.
Treat SoC variants as separate hardware configurations even inside the same device family.
Treat battery-capacity variants as separate hardware configurations.
Treat SIM configuration as a variant dimension when it changes internal packaging or battery capacity.
Preserve exact region, market, model number and SKU whenever a source provides them.
Measurements should join to the narrowest known variant. Unknown region or SKU must remain unknown rather than guessed.

exampleFamilies.modelingRule: Exynos and Snapdragon versions must be separate variants with independent performance, thermal, modem and battery-efficiency evidence.
eSIM-only, nano-SIM/eSIM and other regional configurations may be separate variants when battery capacity or internal packaging differs.
Regional battery-capacity differences must be preserved rather than collapsed into one model entry.
